name: document_exact_de_grab_crossday_source_cv_v1
calibration_repetitions: Native trials 1..N of each class, within one user and day.
selection: On Day2, leave one subject out when estimating population provider weights from frozen probabilities on repetitions 6/7 of the other seven users. Score candidate n0/temperature on each held-out subject's disjoint 1/2/5-shot calibration/evaluation trials. Select minimum mean Day2 log loss across 24 cells, tie-breaking by n0 then temperature. Recompute population prior from all Day2 repetition-6/7 trials. Freeze policy before opening Day3 scores. Day3 is descriptive because previously inspected.
boundary: Public 2048 Hz GRABMyo forearm ring, two overlapping source-trained providers and same-user Day2-to-Day3 calibration. Selection uses Day2 labels, which were previously inspected; Day3 is descriptive, not prospective or own-device validation.
